simple.summary: סִבֹּלֶת (çibbôleth) means an ear of grain First listed occurrence: Judg 12 6.

definitions.full: H5451. sibboleth סִבֹּ֫לֶת noun feminine probably ear of wheat , etc., only Judg 12:6 dialect form of II. שִׁבֹּלֶת q. v. (> = late word שִׁבֹּ֫לֶת tide, flood ); compare Marquardt ZAW viii (1888), 151 ff. but also GFM Bu.
